'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at [[Crimson Badlands]] during any season, at any time, in any weather. A minimum fishing level of 5 is required to catch it.
{{TOC|limit=2}}

==Map==
The Bonefish is one of two fish that can be fished up from the small purple pond located in the southeast corner of the map, south of the entrance to the Badlands via the Desert Railway.
